title: Ciconia ciconia bill-clattering
author: felix.blume
changes: White storks (Ciconia ciconia) displaying in a bird refuge in southern France: the loud, rattling bill clattering storks are famous for, made by snapping the bill open and shut with the head thrown back. Trimmed to 14.60–17.20 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
